decisions.reason: As a perfect binder close to the firm’s long-established finishing and service capabilities, it fits knowledge the firm already has, though the lack of visible own R&D and some overlap with a more automated binder keep the drop risk moderate.

This fully automatic perfect binder is very close to the core offer and directly matches the firm’s stated push toward automation and productivity, so absorptive capacity is high and the incentive to retain it is strong.

An inline and nearline booklet maker sits squarely within the firm’s digital print finishing direction and established support base, making it a product the firm can understand and improve even if its limited visible R&D raises some caution.
